capabilities: color fenced code blocks with built-in syntax palettes
set separate palettes for light and dark appearance
toggle code-block backgrounds and line numbers
control horizontal wrapping of long code lines in the editor
extras: Not yet reviewed by Obsidian staff. Mobile support is marked experimental and untested on real devices; Windows, Linux, and pop-out windows are untested or unsupported. Formerly named Atom One Fenced Syntax. Cannot use custom palette files.
problem: Obsidian themes control the whole app's look, so you cannot recolor code blocks alone without restyling everything else.
summary: Theme selector that colors Markdown fenced code blocks with 15 palette families, plus optional backgrounds, line numbers, and editor wrapping.
